payload.summary: Migration capture from the Hermes built-in profile memory files. The MEMORY.md files of profiles assistant, planner, analyst, and implementer are byte-identical (md5 d7b9c2a223be2c6d9aa6c4f9dd4ac957), so this single envelope carries the shared content for all four. Migrated verbatim at Dustin's request ahead of flipping those profiles to the clptr4p memory provider.

claims.value: terminal toolset NOT in config (only hermes-cli bundle); execute_code needs Docker daemon; sandbox image nikolaik/python-nodejs:python3.11-nodejs20; workspace /mnt/bro/thinktank bind-mounted; subagent role skills at ~/.hermes/skills/roles/<name>/SKILL.md
claims.claim: the Hermes sandbox runs the hermes-cli terminal bundle only, execute_code needs the Docker daemon, the sandbox image is nikolaik/python-nodejs:python3.11-nodejs20, /mnt/bro/thinktank is bind-mounted, and subagent role skills live at ~/.hermes/skills/roles/<name>/SKILL.md

claims.value: /mnt/bro/thinktank/tools/ holds compressed CLI packages plus manifest.toml; subagents extract locally in sandbox; pre-flight check manifest.toml status (blocked = fail task); weekly CVE scan + blocking hook pending; docs: tools/README.md and tools/CONVENTIONS.md

claims.value: the persistence-FP scanner blocks ANY patch to skills executing-plans-inline and subagent-driven-development (pre-existing token-cat / sandbox-path findings trip the re-scan); workaround: create sibling class-level skills; example: per-commit-review-cadence (software-development/)

claims.value: the Hermes terminal tool's foreground-& guard rejects any command containing '&' (bash background launch)
claims.claim: the Hermes terminal tool rejects foreground commands containing an ampersand via its foreground-& guard

claims.value: Dustin's browser environment can include both Brave and Google Chrome; audio2midi extension manual testing is specifically in Google Chrome, so use the Chrome NM path ~/.config/google-chrome/NativeMessagingHosts/ unless he says otherwise
claims.claim: manual testing of the audio2midi extension happens in Google Chrome, so use the Chrome native-messaging path ~/.config/google-chrome/NativeMessagingHosts/ even though Brave may also be installed

claims.value: a2m-host.py must spawn the daemon via 'uv run python3 -m audio2midi.daemon' (NOT sys.executable) so it uses the uv venv Python with aiohttp; 'uv pip install' only checks the lockfile -- use 'uv sync' then 'uv run python3 -c "import <pkg>"' to verify
claims.claim: the audio2midi native host must spawn its daemon with 'uv run python3 -m audio2midi.daemon' rather than sys.executable so it uses the uv venv Python with aiohttp, and dependency installs should be verified with 'uv sync' plus an import check rather than 'uv pip install'

claims.value: PIN (revisit ~Apr 2026): gh CLI is not in the nikolaik base image; tools/gh.tar.gz extracts but /tmp is noexec; a copy at /mnt/bro/thinktank/tools/gh-bin runs but GITHUB_TOKEN is empty in the sandbox so auth fails; likely fix: add GITHUB_TOKEN to docker_pass_env in ~/.hermes/config.yaml (same pattern as OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH); workaround: write issue/PR bodies to docs/issues/ or body-files/ and file from the host shell
claims.claim: gh CLI access from the sandbox is broken (not in the base image, /tmp is noexec, GITHUB_TOKEN is empty), the likely fix is adding GITHUB_TOKEN to docker_pass_env in ~/.hermes/config.yaml, and the workaround is writing issue/PR bodies to docs/issues/ or body-files/ and filing from the host shell
